content.short: Virgo Wallet rewards user engagement with a secure, easy-to-use crypto wallet.
content.description: Virgo Wallet rewards active users with engagement features such as airdrops, loyalty programs, and referrals, while delivering strong security and efficient management of digital assets. It supports more than 500 tokens across 20+ blockchains, including Ethereum, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Avalanche, Fantom, Celo, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum, and other networks. The app focuses on protecting assets and simplifying navigation, offering you meaningful opportunities to earn back as you interact with the platform.
content.meta: Virgo Wallet rewards user engagement with a secure, easy-to-use crypto wallet. Discover Virgo Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
